test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: After 55 years, a sum invested at simple interest at the rate of r percent becomes twice of itself. What is the value of 'r'?
solution:
**Given:**

Time (t) = 55 years

Principal amount (P) = 1

Amount after interest (A) = 2

**Formula Used:**

SI = PRT/100

**Calculation:**

A = SI - P

2SI = SI - P

SI = P

P = (P × R × 55)/100

R = 100/55

R = 20/11%

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
